mentions.name: Three Black and Milds
mentions.description: A creative writing piece titled "Three Black and Milds," depicting a night in Juarez with no commentary or lesson, focusing on the city and its people, what it sells and what is bought.
mentions.source_excerpt: My latest piece, Three Black and Milds, a night in Juarez. No commentary, no lesson, just the city and the people in it, what it sells and what is bought.
